seoTitle: Dog Grooming & Daycare in Delacombe, Ballarat
metaDesc: Dog grooming and daycare in Delacombe, Ballarat. Breed cuts by Mark (formerly Buninyong Dog Grooming), 5.0 stars on Google. Call 0432 840 257.

hero.title: Groomed by someone who knows your dog by name.
hero.lede: Mark has been grooming Ballarat's dogs for years, first as Buninyong Dog Grooming and now at Complete K9 in Delacombe. Breed cuts done right, with daycare on site.

images.heroAlt: Small white dog being scissored by a groomer

servicesHead: Grooming and daycare under one roof
servicesSub: Drop your dog off for a day of play and pick them up freshly groomed.

services.title: Breed & custom clips
services.short: Full clips and breed-specific cuts, done the same way every visit.
services.long: Mark is known for getting tricky cuts right, from Airedales to Labradoodles. Tell him how you like your dog to look and he'll keep it consistent visit after visit.

services.title: Bath & tidy
services.short: Bath, blow-dry, brush-out, face and feet tidy, nails and ears.
services.long: A fresh bath and blow-dry with a tidy of the face, feet and hygiene areas. The perfect in-between groom to keep coats manageable.

services.title: Doggy daycare
services.short: Supervised play in a clean, well-run space with staff who know every dog.
services.long: Daycare gives your dog a fun, social day while you're at work. The team gets to know every dog's personality, and you can add a groom so they come home looking their best.
points: Add a groom to any day

services.title: Puppy first grooms
services.short: A gentle introduction so grooming is something your puppy enjoys.
services.long: A short, calm first visit to get puppies used to the bath, the dryer and being handled, setting them up for a lifetime of easy grooms.
points: Light tidy of face and feet

whyHead: Why Ballarat owners keep coming back
whyText: Complete K9 is a clean, calm salon where the same people look after your dog every time. Some clients have been with Mark for years.

Such a well-run, clean facility with staff who genuinely know every dog and make the effort to understand their personalities.
As a constant return customer of almost four years we can happily say he's the best for our Labradoodle!

faq: Call or text Mark on 0432 840 257, or send the booking form and we'll confirm a time with you.
Can my dog do daycare and a groom on the same day?
Yes. Drop them off in the morning for daycare and they'll be groomed before pick-up.
Do you groom senior or anxious dogs?
Yes. We take things slowly and give older and nervous dogs extra time and breaks.
Are you the same business as Buninyong Dog Grooming?
Yes. Mark ran Buninyong Dog Grooming before moving to the Complete K9 salon in Delacombe.
aboutSub: Formerly Buninyong Dog Grooming, now a full grooming and daycare salon in Delacombe.
aboutParas: Mark started grooming in Buninyong and built up a loyal client list of dogs and owners who wouldn't go anywhere else.
Complete K9 brings grooming and daycare together in one clean, purpose-set-up space in Delacombe, so your dog can play all day and come home looking great.
The team takes the time to get to know each dog, which is why so many clients have been coming back for years.
